analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session. RSI has exited oversold territory but has settled at 68.2 in the neutral zone, indicating weakened upward momentum. MACD histogram shows improvement but the rate of increase has significantly slowed compared to before, suggesting a weak trend reversal signal. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, leaving open the possibility of a Higher Low pattern. However, the ability to break through the swing resistance at $79,488.17 remains uncertain, thus maintaining a cautious stance.
